sentences.en: Uh, but no, let him know in advance that I'll be hostile.
sentences.zh: （无内容）

sentences.en: And, uh, uh, I, I will, I will let him know that.
sentences.zh: 呃，那个，我会，我会让他知道的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So let's talk about, let's talk about rotate.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈，来谈谈 rotate。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Seeing as that was the most riveting podcast you've listened to on ADSP, the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 鉴于那是你听过的关于 ADSP，也就是这个播客，最引人入胜的一期节目。

sentences.en: And at the moment, depending on how long this little segment at the end goes, it's probably going to be the shortest episode yet.
sentences.zh: 目前来看，取决于最后这一小段持续多久，这很可能会成为有史以来最短的一期。

sentences.en: I checked the shortest episode today was 16 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下，今天最短的一期是 16 分钟。

sentences.en: The average is 33.
sentences.zh: 平均时长是 33 分钟。

sentences.en: So we're way under what it needs to be, but I just couldn't let you suffer through the elevator and pigeon conversations that I was so eager to have with Bryce.
sentences.zh: 所以我们远低于正常时长，但我实在不忍心让你忍受我之前急于和 Bryce 进行的那些关于电梯和鸽子的对话。

sentences.en: We are adding a couple of technical tidbits, a couple of conference announcements and reviews of talks that I have watched recently.
sentences.zh: 我们要补充一些技术花絮、一些会议公告，以及我最近观看的演讲回顾。

sentences.en: So first things first, I'm going to be at two conferences in October.
sentences.zh: 首先，我十月份要参加两个会议。

sentences.en: The first is Lambda world, which is being held in Cadiz, Spain from October 2nd to 4th.
sentences.zh: 第一个是 Lambda World，将于 10 月 2 日至 4 日在西班牙加的斯举行。

sentences.en: I will be giving a talk entitled the power of function composition.
sentences.zh: 我将发表一场题为《函数组合的力量》的演讲。

sentences.en: And the workshop is entitled TASA programming in BQN, we walk cap and APL.
sentences.zh: 研讨会的题目是《在 BQN、Walk Cap 和 APL 中进行 TASA 编程》。

sentences.en: So if you're interested in array languages or functional languages, and you are in the area or not in the area and interested in traveling, be sure to check that conference out.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你对数组语言或函数式语言感兴趣，无论你是否在当地，如果有意前往，一定要去看看那个会议。

sentences.en: The second conference is a brand new C++ conference, you might have heard of it already C++ under the sea, a play on Phil Nash's C++ on sea.
sentences.zh: 第二个会议是一个全新的 C++ 会议，你可能已经听说过了，叫“海底 C++”（C++ under the sea），这是对 Phil Nash 的“海边 C++”（C++ on sea）的戏仿。

sentences.en: It's being held in Breda, Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 它将在荷兰布雷达举行。

sentences.en: Hopefully I'm pronouncing that correctly.
sentences.zh: 希望我没读错地名。

sentences.en: It's just outside of Rotterdam.
sentences.zh: 它就在鹿特丹郊外。

sentences.en: I believe it's on October 11th is the day of the conference.
sentences.zh: 我相信会议日期是 10 月 11 日。

sentences.en: October 10th is a workshop day.
sentences.zh: 10 月 10 日是研讨会日。

sentences.en: Both Bryce and I will be there.
sentences.zh: 我和 Bryce 都会参加。

sentences.en: I'll be giving a talk on arrays, fusion, and CPU versus the GPU.
sentences.zh: 我将发表关于数组、融合以及 CPU 与 GPU 对比的演讲。

sentences.en: And Bryce will be giving, I believe, one of his Think Parallel talks.
sentences.zh: 而 Bryce 将会进行一场演讲，我相信是他那系列《并行思考》（Think Parallel）演讲中的一场。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if it is the one that he gave at ACCU and CPP North, or if it's the second edition.
sentences.zh: 我不确定是他之前在 ACCU 和 CPP North 上讲过的那场，还是第二版。

sentences.en: I'm hoping it's the second edition, but maybe we'll talk about that on a future episode.
sentences.zh: 我希望是第二版，但也许我们会在以后的节目中讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: Speaking of the Think Parallel talk, so I'm going to recap very briefly the three talks that I have watched in the first five days of September.
sentences.zh: 说到《并行思考》的演讲，我将非常简要地回顾一下我在九月的前五天里观看的三场演讲。

sentences.en: And one of those talks was
sentences.zh: 其中一场是

sentences.en: Think Parallel.
sentences.zh: 《并行思考》。

sentences.en: I can recommend this talk.
sentences.zh: 我推荐这场演讲。

sentences.en: It's definitely not Bryce's best talk, but it is a good talk.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是 Bryce 最好的演讲，但它是一场好演讲。

sentences.en: However, it is very dense.
sentences.zh: 然而，内容非常密集。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure he achieved the goal he was aiming to achieve.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他是否达到了他预期的目标。

sentences.en: I've read a couple of the comments in the YouTube comment section that basically said they enjoyed the talk,
sentences.zh: 我读了 YouTube 评论区的一些评论，基本上大家说他们很喜欢这场演讲，

sentences.en: but they're going to need to rewatch it a couple times, especially towards the end.
sentences.zh: 但他们需要反复观看几次，特别是在结尾部分。

sentences.en: It is quite complicated.
sentences.zh: 它确实相当复杂。

sentences.en: And there is a ton of code that potentially it could have been split into like a part one and part two.
sentences.zh: 而且有大量的代码，本来可能可以拆分成第一部分和第二部分。

sentences.en: But if you're interested in how scan inclusive scan is and can be implemented in parallel, be sure to check that talk out.
sentences.zh: 但如果你对 scan（包含扫描）如何在并行中实现感兴趣，一定要去看看那场演讲。

sentences.en: The other talk or one of the other talks that I watched was by John Bandela.
sentences.zh: 我观看的另一场演讲，或者说其中一场演讲，是由 John Bandela 主讲的。

sentences.en: I believe there was a co speaker that did not speak.
sentences.zh: 我相信还有一位共同演讲者，但他没有发言。

sentences.en: I can't remember their name off the top of my head.
sentences.zh: 我一时想不起他们的名字。

sentences.en: And they are two Google engineers.
sentences.zh: 他们是两位谷歌工程师。

sentences.en: John was the one presenting at
sentences.zh: John 是在

sentences.en: C++ now.
sentences.zh: C++ Now 上进行演讲的那位。

sentences.en: And, and I should add Bryce's talk was from ACCU 2024.
sentences.zh: 另外，我应该补充一下，Bryce 的演讲来自 ACCU 2024。

sentences.en: And John's talk was on Repel, which is a sibling library to Abseil.
sentences.zh: John 的演讲是关于 Repel 的，它是 Abseil 的姊妹库。

sentences.en: And it is a alternative to the ranges library that is in the
sentences.zh: 它是 C++ 标准库中 ranges 库的替代品，

sentences.en: C++ standard library, as well as flux, which is a competitor to that, and range v3, which was the initial implementation of C++ 20s ranges library.
sentences.zh: 还有 flux（它的竞争对手），以及 range v3（C++ 20 ranges 库的最初实现）。

sentences.en: The differences is, is that it is an eager library, not a lazy library.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，它是一个急切求值（eager）库，而不是惰性求值（lazy）库。

sentences.en: And the API is incredibly different, they don't overload the pipe operator.
sentences.zh: 而且 API 非常不同，他们没有重载管道操作符。

sentences.en: And therefore, you need to pass things in a kind of lisp style.
sentences.zh: 因此，你需要以一种类似 Lisp 的风格来传递参数。

sentences.en: And in order to compose things, you have to make use of a RPL colon colon colon compose.
sentences.zh: 为了组合事物，你必须使用 RPL::compose。

sentences.en: And in order to apply things, you have to make use of a RPL colon colon apply.
sentences.zh: 为了应用事物，你必须使用 RPL::apply。

sentences.en: Honestly, the aesthetics of the library was not a huge fan of, however, you know, it could be much more performant, because it's obviously a completely different
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不太喜欢这个库的美学设计，不过，你知道，它的性能可能会更高，因为它显然与 ranges 的设计完全不同。

sentences.en: design than the ranges.
sentences.zh: 设计。

sentences.en: And it also claims to be a lot safer because it doesn't suffer from a lot of the dangling pointer issues that ranges has famously been criticized for.
sentences.zh: 它还声称更安全，因为它不会遇到 ranges 经常被诟病的许多悬空指针问题。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, it's not open source.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，它不是开源的。

sentences.en: So I would have definitely taken this library for a spin and benchmarked it against the flux range v3 and C++ standard ranges, as I've done in the past, but it's not open source.
sentences.zh: 所以我本来肯定会试用这个库，并像过去那样把它与 flux、range v3 和 C++ 标准 ranges 进行基准测试，但它不是开源的。

sentences.en: So until it is, we won't know which is better.
sentences.zh: 所以除非它开源，否则我们无法知道哪个更好。

sentences.en: But they said that they were working towards open sourcing it in the future.
sentences.zh: 但他们说他们正在努力在未来将其开源。

sentences.en: If folks are interested, I'm interested.
sentences.zh: 如果大家感兴趣的话，我也很感兴趣。

sentences.en: So if john, you hear this, hopefully, Google can work towards that.
sentences.zh: 所以 John，如果你听到这个，希望谷歌能朝着这个方向努力。

sentences.en: And the third and final talk, which was the best talk of the three by far was Dave Abraham's keynote that
sentences.zh: 第三场，也是最后一场演讲，也是这三场中最好的一场，是 Dave Abrahams 在 C++ on Sea 上刚刚发布的演讲，

sentences.en: just came out a couple days ago from C++ on C, it was about at a high level, the Hilo language, but actually not so much.
sentences.zh: 高层面上讲是关于 Hilo 语言的，但实际上并没有讲太多。

sentences.en: I don't think he even showed any Hilo code, he might have showed a tiny bit, but
sentences.zh: 我觉得他甚至没有展示任何 Hilo 代码，可能展示了一点点，但

sentences.en: it was more of a philosophical talk about MVS mutable value semantics and the history of where MVS and
sentences.zh: 这更多是一场关于 MVS（可变值语义）的哲学演讲，以及 MVS 和

sentences.en: Hilo came from in Swift.
sentences.zh: Hilo 在 Swift 中起源的历史。

sentences.en: And he mentions Stepanov and generic programming, absolutely fantastic.
sentences.zh: 他提到了 Stepanov 和泛型编程，简直太棒了。

sentences.en: Also, he shouts out Ken Iverson and APL in the first couple minutes of the talk.
sentences.zh: 此外，他在演讲开始的前几分钟还向 Ken Iverson 和 APL 致敬。

sentences.en: We absolutely love that, folks.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对喜欢这个，伙计们。

sentences.en: We absolutely love that.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对喜欢这个。

sentences.en: And Dave is just a fantastic speaker across the board.
sentences.zh: Dave 是一位非常出色的演讲者。

sentences.en: We cannot recommend this talk highly enough, definitely the best of the three in the pipeline.
sentences.zh: 我们强烈推荐这场演讲，绝对是这三场中最好的一场。

sentences.en: Oh, also, I should mention RPL is the namespace on the Repel library.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，我应该提到 RPL 是 Repel 库的命名空间。

sentences.zh: 显然，Repel 是 Abseil 的同义词。
